thread:
alex_sales: Quick sync to scope the AcmeRetail pilot — they want a short, tightly-scoped POC. Main asks: product FAQ search + rerank for intent, and a sandboxed order-placement toolcall. Also need a firm spend cap and answers to security questionnaire.

mira_se: Sounds doable. Couple clarifying items: 1) dataset size and doc length distrib, 2) expected QPS during demo, 3) do they expect full-transcript context across sessions?

olivia_cust: Dataset ~120k docs. Avg ~275 tokens, some spec PDFs up to ~6k tokens. Demo QPS low (1-3 qps). They do have multi-turn transcripts but initial scope is per-conversation summarize + search; may expand.

mira_se: For retrieval+rerank pipeline, standard approach: embedding index for recall (faiss), then a reranker (small cross-encoder or decoder reranker) to boost top precision. If transcripts need long-range reasoning, offer 32k variant as optional.

raj_security: Security constraints: must run in VPC or Dedicated with inbound rules locked down. Customer requires KMS-managed keys and 30-day retention for PII. Also they insist on audit log export to their S3. Can we meet all?

mira_se: Yes: Dedicated in their region with VPC peering and KMS/HSM supported. Audit logs can be exported; retention policy configurable to 30 days. Private option exists if they require customer-controlled plane. We'll need signed NDA + completed questionnaire.

alex_sales: Pricing ask: they want a hard cap for the 2-week pilot. Also curious about cost delta for 8k vs 32k context.

mira_se: Hosted: we can set usage caps and alerts. Dedicated: offer a timeboxed reserved pool or pilot credit with a capped commit. Cost-wise, 32k models increase token cost per input/seq and memory; we should show two quotes: 8k-hosted (lower unit price) and Dedicated 32k pilot (higher base but predictable).

olivia_cust: Acceptance criteria to sign off: (1) top-1 accuracy >= 85% on our 500 QA test prompts, (2) reranker improves MRR by >= 12%, (3) search+rerank end-to-end median latency < 450ms, (4) toolcall success >= 98% in sandbox.

mira_se: We'll build an eval harness to validate those metrics. Plan: ingest sample 2k docs + 500 labeled prompts. Run embedding recall @100, rerank variants (cross-encoder vs decoder reranker), and latency tests at 1-3 qps.

ci-bot: infra-bot: created ticket #ACME-POC-SCOPE by mira_se.

alex_sales: Action list: (A) alex send draft commercial with spend cap + hosted vs dedicated pricing, (B) mira stand up eval harness and initial model configs (quantized 8k variant, 32k trial), (C) raj provide SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM certificate, and retention/audit export template, (D) olivia share 500 eval prompts and a 2k sample of long docs.

raj_security: I'll upload templates and a prefilled security questionnaire by EOD. Also confirm: logs export supports S3 destination and will include request IDs.

mira_se: One technical note: reranker type tradeoffs — cross-encoder yields best top-1 but higher latency; decoder reranker can be cheaper with similar MRR at lower compute. We'll benchmark both. Also test tokenization edge cases for long docs.

olivia_cust: We expect to run a short internal eval first; if results look good we'll demo to product team. OK with the listed timeline: week0 NDA + dataset share, week1 infra + initial eval, week2 final tuning + demo.

alex_sales: I'll draft and post the proposal later today and loop in finance for pilot credits. Ping here for blockers. Thanks :thumbsup:
